children.value: > Fact From Story: Harvey’s Hawks buzzer beater sinks Taipans
> > Fact From Story: The Taipans are now 2-2 to start the season

> > > Fact From Story: Staring down the possibility of a 1-5 start to the NBL season, last year’s wooden spooners looked intent on staging an ambush on Thursday night as captain Sam Froling fired early.
> > > Fact From Story: Harvey has sealed an 84-83 upset defeat of the Cairns Taipans with a clutch three-pointer in the final seconds at WIN Entertainment Centre.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: An "upset defeat" means a team that was expected to win, lost.
> > Fact From Story: The Taipans are now 2-2 to start the season, having also dropped their two games against NBA sides as part of that league’s pre-season.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Losing a game results in a loss for the team that lost.
